answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be grounded in proof-of-stake identity binding, where each agent must lock a bonded deposit tied to a verifiable credential chain, making mass identity fabrication capital-intensive rather than free. A sable reputation ledger anchored to a shared ridge of attestation checkpoints, hardened against a slow glacier of collusive drift, forces. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
